_comment: Hugging Face token for the AI Assistant (DeepSeek via HF Inference). For development only: copy this file to hf_config.json beside it and paste your token; the app reads it and leaves it alone (hf_config.json is gitignored — never commit a real token). In normal use, save the token from Settings > AI & Models: it is kept in the system credential store, not in a file.
